text.description: Ready for immediate occupation, Plot 42 'The Birch' is a cutting-edge 3 bedroom end-of-terrace home constructed to outstanding ecological standards with an enviable EPC Band A rating. Heating is delivered via an ultra-quiet Daikin air source heat pump with wet underfloor heating throughout the ground floor, complemented by an integrated solar PV array. The ground floor showcases an open-plan kitchen diner with quartz worktops and Siemens appliances, a bright reception room with French doors to the private enclosed lawned garden, plus a downstairs cloakroom/WC. The first floor offers three bedrooms, including master bedroom with en-suite shower room and a luxury family bathroom. Outside features a driveway with parking for 2 cars and a 7kW EV charging point. Covered by a 10-year NHBC warranty. Chain free.
